title: AI rollout fail kyun hota hai
content:
SOME companies are pulling back on AI.
Here's WHY.
X pe is hafte ye bada discussion chal raha hai.
Rushed AI rollouts... aur phir mistakes fix karne mein ghante.
Teams spent more time cleaning up than they saved.
But here's the thing.
Problem AI nahi hai.
The problem is HOW it was rolled out.
Main clients ke saath kaam karte hue...
teen galtiyan baar baar dekhta hoon.
Number one. Sab kuch EK saath automate karna.
Management excited hota hai, aur bolta hai... sab AI pe daal do.
Support, sales, HR, sab ek hi mahine mein.
That never works.
Start with ONE boring task. Bas ek.
Something repetitive, something you can measure.
Jab wo chal jaaye, tab next task.
Number two. Koi human check nahi.
AI directly customer ko reply bhej raha hai...
koi dekh hi nahi raha.
Ek galat jawab, aur trust khatam.
The fix is simple.
AI draft kare... insaan APPROVE kare.
Jab results consistently sahi aayein, tab dheere dheere automation badhao.
Number three. Koi measurement nahi.
If you don't measure it, you can't defend it.
Pehle din se track karo.
Kitna time bacha? Kitni galtiyan hui? Kitna paisa bacha?
Jab numbers saamne hote hain...
AI project band nahi hota, aur bada hota hai.
Toh formula simple hai.
Small start. Human in the loop. Clear numbers.
That is how AI actually sticks in a business.
Ye boring lagta hai, par yahi kaam karta hai.
Aur agar aapki company bhi AI try karke peeche hat gayi hai...
it is not too late.
Bas sahi tarike se dobara start karna hai.
Ek example imagine karo.
Maan lo ek company ne customer support pe AI lagaya, bina testing ke.
Galat refund promises gaye, aur team ko sab manually theek karna pada.
Same company, if they had started with AI drafts and human approval,
would have saved time instead of losing it.
Aapke business mein AI sahi tarike se lagana hai?
DM me 'AI'.
